policy.h1_blocker: Unknown geometry or mating truth changes the dimensioned mockup, routing corridor, enclosure aperture or user-reviewed placement and must close before H1.1.4 is frozen.
policy.h5_received_sample_gate: The paper geometry is sufficient for H1; received-part fit, feel, endurance, electrical, RF, acoustic or thermal behaviour closes in H5 before fabrication release.

execution_constraint.sequence: Exhaust controlled public sources, compare function-preserving documented replacements, request missing manufacturer data without an order, and consider a smallest evidence sample only as a separately approved last resort.

gates.evidence_boundary: Official QDtech sources prove the HMX035CTFT-001 marking, complete-donor 54.5x101.5-mm reserve, 40-contact electrical map and 54.5x83.0x3.2-mm LCD/CTP screen body. L2-DISP-ADP-001-A fixes a 25.5x12.0-mm replaceable adapter, exact 2.0-mm 40-contact DF40 board mate, direct one-to-one copper and an active dual-contact FH34SRJ panel ZIF. The main UI board and enclosure no longer depend on an inferred raw-flex outline or exposed-contact side.
gates.unknown: Standalone order identity, current-lot complete FPC outline, thickness, stiffener, adhesive, bend path and actual insertion/retention in the selected dual-contact ZIF remain received-display properties; a mismatch may revise only the small adapter and its panel-side connector.
gates.closure: Incoming inspection measures the current HMX035CTFT-001 tail and proves insertion, retention, bend clearance and continuity on a replaceable adapter revision before fabrication release.

gates.evidence_boundary: Ebyte's current specification and official PcbLib prove the E01-ML01IPX outline and land pattern; Ebyte's current accessory catalog identifies the matching interface as IPX/IPEX Gen1. Exact active TE 2118651-2 30-mm UMCC Gen1 jumpers and Hirose U.FL-R-SMT-1(10) board mates define all three paper feed assemblies. H1 reserves a cable corridor from the complete module-face envelope instead of inventing a connector axis absent from the PcbLib.
gates.unknown: The connector axis and current-lot receptacle manufacturer's exact MPN, actual fit/retention, bend/strain behaviour and end-to-end RF loss remain received-part properties. H1.2/H1.6 must prove the conservative module-face-to-board-receptacle corridor without relying on a nominal axis.
gates.closure: Incoming inspection confirms the fitted receptacle is Gen1, and all three complete feed coupons pass fit, retention, flex/service, insertion-loss and return-loss tests in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: M5Stack proves the 84x24x15.287-mm Cap envelope, 2x7 2.54-mm topology and 56-mm retention pitch. Samtec proves the exact HLE-107-02-G-DV-PE-LC pass-through body, standard 0.635-mm square-post class, 1.78-mm minimum insertion and absence of a closed bottoming limit. H1 fixes the Cap body to the retention datums and lets the undocumented post length pass through the raised rail.
gates.unknown: Current-lot U214 post section, insertion force, contact retention, repeated-cycle fit, retention-screw engagement and final compliant rail preload remain received-part properties; none changes the bounded H1 exterior envelope or main-board placement.
gates.closure: Incoming inspection and an exact HLE coupon verify the current U214 post, insertion/withdrawal force, contact continuity, cycle life and retention engagement before fabrication release.

gates.evidence_boundary: Five exact, active and orderable OMRON B3S-1100P switches form UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT and OK. Every direction is a separate direct-press serial component; no custom cap, plunger, cross or guide exists. The manufacturer drawing fixes each 6.6x6.0x4.3-mm body, 3.3-mm plunger, force, travel and IEC IP67-equivalent switch boundary.
gates.unknown: Assembled enclosure opening access, accidental-press margin, multi-button feel, sealing boundary and endurance.
gates.closure: The received five-button/front-panel assembly passes access, force, independent and adjacent actuation, contradictory-pair rejection, sealing-boundary and endurance tests in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: SA818S Rev 1.8 plus the official manufacturer package archive define one common 35.60 x 19.00-mm, 18-land host pattern for SA818S-U and SA818S-V; each contact-12 RF corridor is independent.
gates.unknown: Received SA818S-U/V lot identity, common-land tolerance, solder fillet and thermal assembly behaviour.
gates.closure: Incoming identity check, one common land-pattern coupon populated with both variants, solder inspection and power/thermal smoke test pass in H5; conducted RF remains H8.

gates.evidence_boundary: Exact shaft, knob and plan envelopes are manufacturer-dimensioned and fit the H1 rear-face reserve.
gates.unknown: Insertion depth, retention, push travel, feel and final rear depth on received parts.
gates.closure: Received fit/travel/endurance coupon passes in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: The exact B3S-1100P body, 3.3-mm plunger and height/tolerance are manufacturer-dimensioned; no speculative cap is used.
gates.unknown: PCB/enclosure press feel, accidental-press margin and endurance.
gates.closure: Received control coupon passes travel, force, accessibility and endurance tests in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: The exact C&K body and side-actuator envelope are manufacturer-dimensioned and the opening direction is explicit.
gates.unknown: Received side access, detent force, accidental motion and endurance.
gates.closure: Received switch/aperture coupon passes access, force and endurance tests in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: The exact Seeed 1125R-SMT-4P body, land pattern and outward cable direction are controlled.
gates.unknown: Received Grove cable insertion, retention, strain relief and repeated mating.
gates.closure: Exact connector and ecosystem cable pass received fit/endurance checks in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: The corrected mockup uses the exact 69.7x18.7-mm protected-cell envelopes inside the manufacturer-dimensioned rotated Keystone 1048P holder.
gates.unknown: Received insertion force, contact compression, polarity protection, vibration and thermal cycling.
gates.closure: One exact holder and one matched same-lot pair of accepted protected cells pass dimensional, insertion, retention, vibration and thermal tests in H5; mixed MPN, lot, age or state of charge remains forbidden.

gates.evidence_boundary: Exact 30-mm cable assemblies, module RF axes, U.FL board mates and conservative routed corridors are in the H1 collision model.
gates.unknown: Actual bend radius, strain relief, insertion force, retention and RF loss after assembly.
gates.closure: Received cables and connector coupons pass fit, bend, retention and conducted-RF tests in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: H1 fixes the controlled screen body, replaceable adapter bay, exact DF40 stack and dual-contact panel connector; electrical and optical behavior remain qualification evidence.
gates.unknown: QSPI/touch operation, optical quality, backlight current/thermal, flex endurance and lot repeatability.
gates.closure: Received display lot passes electrical, optical, thermal and flex-endurance qualification in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: Exact speaker/microphone bodies fit the sourced envelopes; the microphone retains a downward interface direction without inventing aperture geometry on the PCB-face view.
gates.unknown: Enclosure acoustic treatment, cavity resonance, sealing, feedback, microphone response and vibration.
gates.closure: Received acoustic stack passes level, response, feedback, sealing and vibration tests in H5.

gates.evidence_boundary: The active and orderable Same Sky SJ-43504-SMT-TR manufacturer drawing fixes the shielded 14.6x7.5x5.0-mm mid-mount body, four CTIA-wired conductors, two internal switches and required PCB cutout. H1 places its opening on the right UI-board edge without increasing the interboard height or colliding with another body.
gates.unknown: Received cutout tolerance, shield and solder-tab fit, enclosure opening, plug insertion/withdrawal force, CTIA and three-pole TRS behavior, retention and unplug transient remain assembled-product properties.
gates.closure: The exact connector, board-cutout coupon and final enclosure opening pass dimensional, CTIA/TRS electrical, insertion, retention, detect, microphone-selection and endurance checks in H5.
